title: Reality and Illusion
summary: Looking for weapons against Fire Demon Country, Wang Lin searches the deep wilderness for Ling Tianhou's sword qi lost with Zi Shu, but Teng Yun of the Heyun Sect claims the body and the sword qi turns out to be his own sect's. Demon Emperor Gu Yunchi, whom Wang Lin had once drunk with on a pleasure boat, gives him a jade slip with his authority, and on the Songtao City battlefield Wang Lin captures Mo Fei, whose men had tried to kill him. Using soul search on Mo Fei, he learns that all twelve Da Lou swords were summoned to Fire Demon Country by Tan Lang, an Illusory Yin cultivator who helped kill Situ Nan. Yao Xixue then reveals that the Demon Spirit Land is the abode of Celestial Emperor Qin Lin, made of four illusory abodes and one real one, and that in ten years the Blood Ancestor, All-Seer and Ling Tianhou will come for it. Wang Lin moves the Soul Refining Tribe to the border, opens the second seal on his thunder beast, and ten years later Jin Shaofei of the Cultivation Alliance comes with Sun Yunshan and Immortal Guard Xiang Dingxiu to take him; Wang Lin defeats the guard, and Sun Yunshan begs him to save the Xuanyuan Sect from the alliance's Immortal Ancestor, who controls cultivators with immortal seeds.

changes: Main source: AnimeKhor Indonesian fansub (ep125.id.srt) and its caption cards; the YouTube English track for this episode is machine-made and garbled, used only for cross-checks.
Teng Yun id 'teng-yun-heyun' to keep him apart from the Teng clan's Teng Yun (glossary lists both).
flags: The Tan Lang name is first given as 'Gong Lang' then 'Tan Lang' (419-422s).
Shi San and Ouyang Hua are not named in the tribe scene (668-771s); assumed from context.
Whether Teng Yun's claim is honest is not shown; Wang Lin lets him go.
